# 2.6 CWM SIG W/ corrected traits 
This script evaluates the significance of community-weighted means (CWMs) for corrected trait data. It performs permutation-based testing (CWM.sig), integrates spatial structure (MEMs), runs parallel computations, and summarizes results across 1000 simulations.

Note: This script requires more than 8 GiB of RAM and should be run in a fresh R session with an empty environment.

```{r}
# This script require more than 8 GiB of RAM Memory
# Always run in a clean r-session with an empty environment

rm(list = ls())   # Clear all objects from the workspace
gc()              # Clean up unused memory

# Load required packages
library(SYNCSA)
library(ape)
library(openxlsx)
library(vegan)
library(car)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyverse)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)

# Source user-defined functions
source("func/summarize_trees.R")   # Function to summarize CWM.sig results
source("func/cwm_sig.txt") # CWM.sig function
```

# Start

```{r}
set.seed(811) ## Define reproducibility
## Set the return of numeric values only (not scientific notations)
options(scipen = 999)
N = 1000 # number of elements (ie. trees or repetitions)
runs = 9999 # number of iteration for CWM.Sig
```

# Load data

```{r}
org_data <- readRDS("data/org_data.RDS")
#Load adjusted traits corrected
scomp <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/SCOMP.RDS")
#Load models
models <- read_xlsx("outputs/Corrected/mod_select_cwm.xlsx", sheet = "nice_mode_S")
# Load Moran Eigenvector Maps
mem_scomp <- readRDS("outputs/mem_scomp.RDS")
```

# Start parallel computing
```{r}
no_cores <- detectCores() - 10  # Adjust core usage depending on machine, try to set less cores to do not
## occupy too much memory during the permutations of CWM.SIG
registerDoParallel(cores = no_cores)
cl <- makeCluster(no_cores)     # Initialize cluster
```

# Computing CWM for corrected data
```{r}
# Rhyzome Diameter
models$models[models$n_sel>500]
view(models)
# First we organize data with community, trait corrected for
# phylogeny and env.
# I organize trait data based on the tree tips organization.
# Community data was organized matching with env data.

diam <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    organize.syncsa(
      org_data$community,
      traits = data.frame(diam = scomp$riz_diam[[i]]),
      envir = org_data$environmental
    )
  }

# Now, we are using foreach to compute CWM.Sig
# This function is available on func/table_cwm.R
# It only organize the CWM.Sig results for each phylogenetic
# scenario in a data.frame and automatize the use of MEM.
# Setting .combine as rbind makes each result be combined by rows.

result_diam <- foreach(i = 1:N, .combine = 'rbind') %dopar%
  {
    get_cwm(
      comm = diam[[i]]$community,
      trait = diam[[i]]$traits,
      env = diam[[i]]$environmental,
      formula = diam ~ nitrogen + plot_size + samp_size,
      runs = runs, model = F
    )
  }

# This function only resumes the results of get_cwm
# in one data.frame, computing mean and sd for each parameter
sig.diam.df <- table_cwm(result_diam)

# We need to free some memory space
gc()

# After we repeat the process for each trait...
# Short Creeping Rhizome
models[grep(x = models$models, "Short"), ]
models[grep(x = models$models, "Short"), 2]

rcr <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    organize.syncsa(
      org_data$community,
      traits = data.frame(r_cr = scomp$riz_cr[[i]]),
      envir = org_data$environmental
    )
  }

result_rcr <- foreach(i = 1:N, .combine = 'rbind') %dopar%
  {
    get_cwm( model = F,
      comm = rcr[[i]]$community,
      trait = rcr[[i]]$traits,
      env = rcr[[i]]$environmental,
      formula = r_cr ~ ann_prec + prec_seas + plot_size + samp_size,
      runs = runs
    )
  }

sig.rcr.df <- table_cwm(result_rcr)

gc()

# Compact Rhizome
models[grep(x = models$models, "rcomp"), ] #show first model
models[grep(x = models$models, "rcomp"), 1] #show first model

rcomp <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    organize.syncsa(
      org_data$community,
      traits = data.frame(rcomp = scomp$riz_comp[[i]]),
      envir = org_data$environmental
    )
  }

result_rcomp <- foreach(i = 1:N, .combine = 'rbind') %dopar%
  {
    get_cwm( model = F,
      comm = rcomp[[i]]$community,
      trait = rcomp[[i]]$traits,
      env = rcomp[[i]]$environmental,
      formula = rcomp ~ cec + plot_size + samp_size,
      runs = runs
    )
  }

sig.rcomp.df <- table_cwm(result_rcomp)


gc()

# Laminar segmentation
models$models
models[grep(x = models$models, "mseg"), 1] #show first model

lmseg <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    organize.syncsa(
      org_data$community,
      traits = data.frame(lmseg = scomp$lam_mseg[[i]]),
      envir = org_data$environmental
    )
  }

result_lmseg <- foreach(i = 1:N, .combine = 'rbind') %dopar%
  {
    get_cwm( model = F,
      comm = lmseg[[i]]$community,
      trait = lmseg[[i]]$traits,
      env = lmseg[[i]]$environmental,
      formula = lmseg ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size,
      runs = runs
    )
  }


sig.lmseg.df <- table_cwm(result_lmseg)

gc()

# Buds
models$models
buds <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    organize.syncsa(
      org_data$community,
      traits = data.frame(buds = scomp$buds[[i]]),
      envir = org_data$environmental
    )
  }

result_buds <- foreach(i = 1:N, .combine = 'rbind') %dopar%
  {
    get_cwm( model = F,
      comm = buds[[i]]$community,
      trait = buds[[i]]$traits,
      env = buds[[i]]$environmental,
      formula = buds ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size,
      runs = runs
    )
  }

# Summary  results of cwm.sig
sig.buds.df <- table_cwm(result = result_buds)

gc()
# Laminae dimorphism
models$models
lmorf <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    organize.syncsa(
      org_data$community,
      traits = data.frame(lmorf = scomp$lmorf[[i]]),
      envir = org_data$environmental
    )
  }

result_lmorf <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    get_cwm( model = F,
      comm = lmorf[[i]]$community,
      trait = lmorf[[i]]$traits,
      env = lmorf[[i]]$environmental,
      formula = lmorf ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size,
      runs = runs
    )
  } %>%
  bind_rows()

# Summary  results of cwm.sig
sig.lmorf.df <- table_cwm(result_lmorf) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate_all(as.character)

gc()

# Spore Chlorophyll
models$models
chl <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    organize.syncsa(
      org_data$community,
      traits = data.frame(chl = scomp$chl[[i]], mem_scomp[[i]]),
      envir = org_data$environmental
    )
  }

result_chl <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    get_cwm( model = F,
      comm = chl[[i]]$community,
      trait = chl[[i]]$traits,
      env = cbind.data.frame(chl[[i]]$environmental, mem_scomp[[i]]), # To this model we need to indicate MEMs
      # due to spatial autocorrelation detected before
      formula = chl ~ prec_seas + plot_size + samp_size,
      runs = runs
    )
  } %>%
  bind_rows()

# Summary  results of cwm.sig
sig.chl.df <- table_cwm(result_chl) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate_all(as.character)

gc()
# -> Stop parallel computing ####
stopCluster(cl)
```
 
# Output data 

```{r}
# Here, I united the raw data (from get_cwm) in
# one df

cwm.results_full <-
  full_join(result_rcr, result_diam) %>%
  full_join(result_rcomp) %>%
  full_join(result_buds) %>%
  full_join(result_lmseg) %>%
  full_join(result_lmorf) %>%
  full_join(result_chl) 


# Here, I united the summaries (from table_cwm) in
# one df
cwm.results <-
  full_join(sig.rcr.df, sig.diam.df) %>%
  full_join(sig.rcomp.df) %>%
  full_join(sig.buds.df) %>%
  full_join(sig.lmseg.df) %>%
  full_join(sig.lmorf.df) %>%
  full_join(sig.chl.df) 
```

# Saving data
```{r}
wb_cwm <- list(full_result = cwm.results_full, summary = cwm.results)

write.xlsx(
  x = wb_cwm,
  file = "outputs/Corrected/cwm_sig_tcor.xlsx",
  keepNA = T,
  rowNames = T
)
```
